newsitem.title: FINLAND: Baltic Ice-New restrictions due in Gulf of Bothnia.
newsitem.headline: Baltic Ice-New restrictions due in Gulf of Bothnia.

text.p: Tighter restrictions to navigation are due on January 17 in the Gulf of Bothnia as ice thickens further, the Finnish Institute of Marine Research said in its twice-weekly report on Monday.

Requirements from January 17 will be ice class IA and a minimum deadweight of 3,000 tonnes for Kemi, Tornio and Raahe, ice class IA with a minimum deadweight of 2,000 tonnes for Kokkola and Pietarsaari and ice classes I and II for Kaskinen, Pori, Rauma and Uusikaupunki, the institute said.

Four icebreakers were on station near St Petersburg and Vyborg in the eastern Gulf of Finland, three in the northern end of the Gulf of Bothnia, two in the middle of the Gulf of Bothnia and one outside Parnu in the Gulf of Riga.
